evaluation.overall_comment: The translation is highly competent and effectively captures the educational, conversational tone of a physics podcast in natural Macedonian. Complex quantum mechanics and optics concepts are broken down clearly without losing scientific accuracy. The main limitations are a minor dialogue line omission near the middle and a few slightly literal phrasings that cause momentary stiffness but do not impede comprehension. Overall, it successfully bridges the source text and target audience while maintaining pedagogical clarity and scientific precision. It falls into the high-quality category with only minor structural/lexical imperfections affecting strict completeness and flow.
